name: R3 single-run clean and connected comparison
limits: Existing uncapped generation/time/call settings; native finite model context. Preserve native harness needs_attention pauses; never silently resume a rejected lead batch.
clean_inputs: Original frozen clean state content and assignments, rendered with current engine.packet to include current metadata; audited all original content keys unchanged. Same role prompts as connected.
scoring: Frozen 96 meaning-based checks. Semantic grading after saved answers; no keyword scoring, no score for pending output. Keep execution incomplete/not reached distinct.
custodian: Existing frozen policy and supervised matching at genuine evidence boundary; no fabricated evidence or private rubric in model inputs.
reuse: Each already scored same-runtime connected result is used once, no fresh connected repeats for those models. Qwen uses latest fresh replication, not both copies.
hardware: Existing local profiles preserved. New models may use recorded CPU offload at native context. Model digests/version pinned.
ordering: MiniCheck remains included, scheduled last due earlier non-completion. Reasoning-model thinking=false matches prior comparison settings.
